device.modelDescription: MCP conformance fixture: one action per result shape the MCP layer must handle

actionList.name: object_out
actionList.description: Returns {text: "ok"}; declares an object output schema.

actionList.name: no_schema_string
actionList.description: Returns a plain string and declares no output schema.

actionList.name: no_schema_object
actionList.description: Returns an object and declares no output schema.

actionList.name: no_schema_empty
actionList.description: Returns no output and declares no output schema.

actionList.name: prefix_items_out
actionList.description: Returns a pair; its output schema uses the 2020-12 prefixItems keyword.

actionList.name: coded_error
actionList.description: Fails with a typed error; declares a strict object output schema that an error code object would not satisfy.

actionList.name: strict_out
actionList.description: Returns a property its own output schema forbids, so the runtime rejects the call.
